caseName: American Bell International, Inc. v. Islamic Republic of Iran
caseNameFull: American Bell International, Inc. v. Islamic Republic of Iran

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. Motion of petitioner to expedite consideration of the petition for writ of certiorari granted. Certiorari before judgment denied.

Justice Stewart took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and this petition.
